newsitem.title: USA: Brazil to set rules for CVRD sale on Friday - BNDES.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to set rules for CVRD sale on Friday - BNDES.

text.p: Brazil's government will publish the rules for the privitization auction of mining giant Companhia Vale Do Rio Doce (CVRD) on Friday, said an official at the country's National Development Bank (BNDES).
"We will publish the public offering rules (for CVRD) on Friday," said Jose Pio Borges, vice president and director of privitization at the BNDES, told Reuters here.
"The document will have all the details of the auction except the price, which will be announced around 60 days before the sale," he added.
Brazil's CVRD privatization auction is scheduled to take place in mid-Febuary 1997.

Borges, who is in New York to meet with businesses and potential investors, said he also held talks with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission officials regarding the launching of CVRD's level 2 American Depositary Receipt (ADR).
Borges said he was optimistic about the talks and hoped to have the companies ADR's ready by the time of CVRD's sale.
"The SEC officials are enthusiastic about the globalization of the markets," Borges said. "We hope the ADR will be available by the time of the auction."
Borges said Brazil's power utility Light is also mulling a level 2 ADR in New York.
